questions.prompt: What does a parameter typed `&str` indicate to the caller?

options.a: The function will deallocate the string when it returns
options.b: The function borrows the string; the caller retains ownership
options.c: The argument must have static lifetime

questions.prompt: What happens when passing a `String` value to a function parameter typed `String` (without `&`)?

options.a: The function borrows the string immutably
options.b: The string is implicitly duplicated via Copy
options.c: The function takes ownership and the argument is moved from the caller

questions.prompt: How would you change `consume`'s parameter type `message: String` so caller strings are borrowed rather than moved?
